name: affix-forge
author: rhwski
description: Monsters drop equipment with 1-4 random affixes from a pool of 214 options in four rarity tiers, and the Affix Smith in Prontera moves, removes and rerolls affixes for a price you set.

settings.label: Modded drop chance (% of the monster's own drop rate)
settings.description: Each equipment item in a monster's drop list gets an extra roll at its normal rate times this percentage. 100 = same rate as the stock drop, 0 = mod off.

settings.label: Minimum bonus attributes per item
settings.description: Every modded item gets at least this many (1-4).

settings.label: Maximum bonus attributes per item
settings.description: Every modded item gets at most this many (1-4). The count is picked evenly between minimum and maximum.

settings.label: Scale values with monster level
settings.description: Higher level monsters roll stronger values. Off = every monster rolls the base values.

settings.label: One affix per stat
settings.description: On: an item never rolls two affixes of the same stat, so it can have MaxHP or MaxHP %, not both (same for MaxSP, ATK, MATK and ASPD). Off: only the exact same affix is kept from repeating.

settings.label: Drop on the ground, unidentified, with a pillar of light
settings.description: Off: the modded item goes straight into your inventory, identified. On: it drops on the ground next to you, unidentified, with a colored pillar like a card drop (blue = 1 attribute, yellow = 2, purple = 3-4). Pick it up and identify it to see the attributes.

settings.label: Ground drop: show the pillar of light
settings.description: Only used with the ground drop setting. If dropped items do not appear in the game, turn this off: some clients cannot draw the colored pillar and skip the item.

settings.label: Rarity weight: Tier 1 (common)
settings.description: How often each attribute is rolled from Tier 1: flat stats, ATK/MATK, HP/SP, HIT/FLEE/CRIT, recovery. Relative to the other three weights.

settings.label: Rarity weight: Tier 2 (uncommon)
settings.description: Percent stats, ASPD, cast/delay, resistances and damage-taken reductions.

settings.label: Rarity weight: Tier 3 (rare)
settings.description: Damage bonuses vs races, elements and sizes, crit damage, indestructible gear.

settings.label: Rarity weight: Tier 4 (epic)
settings.description: Boss damage, ignore DEF/MDEF, bonus EXP, element conversion. Set 0 to never roll them.

settings.label: Value multiplier (%)
settings.description: Scales every rolled value. 100 = as designed, 200 = double. The per-option caps still apply.

settings.label: Move all affixes: price (zeny)
settings.description: Zeny charged for moving the affixes of one item onto another. 0 = free.

settings.label: Move all affixes: materials
settings.description: Materials used up when moving affixes. Up to 3 entries separated by commas, each ITEMID:AMOUNT (an Etc or usable item, e.g. 7321:5) or same:AMOUNT (that many plain pieces of equipment of the same kind as the item, e.g. same:2 = two more daggers for a dagger). Plain means not equipped, no refine, no cards or enchants, no affixes. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Reroll: price (zeny)
settings.description: Zeny charged for rerolling the affixes of one item. 0 = free.

settings.label: Reroll: materials
settings.description: Materials used up when rerolling. Up to 3 entries separated by commas, each ITEMID:AMOUNT (an Etc or usable item, e.g. 7321:5) or same:AMOUNT (that many plain pieces of equipment of the same kind as the item, e.g. same:2 = two more daggers for a dagger). Plain means not equipped, no refine, no cards or enchants, no affixes. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Move one affix: price (zeny)
settings.description: Zeny charged for moving a single chosen affix onto another item. 0 = free.

settings.label: Move one affix: materials
settings.description: Materials used up when moving one affix. Up to 3 entries separated by commas, each ITEMID:AMOUNT (an Etc or usable item, e.g. 7321:5) or same:AMOUNT (that many plain pieces of equipment of the same kind as the item, e.g. same:2 = two more daggers for a dagger). Plain means not equipped, no refine, no cards or enchants, no affixes. Leave empty for none.

settings.label: Remove an affix: price (zeny)
settings.description: Zeny charged for removing one chosen affix from an item. 0 = free.

settings.label: Remove an affix: materials
settings.description: Materials used up when removing an affix. Up to 3 entries separated by commas, each ITEMID:AMOUNT (an Etc or usable item, e.g. 7321:5) or same:AMOUNT (that many plain pieces of equipment of the same kind as the item, e.g. same:2 = two more daggers for a dagger). Plain means not equipped, no refine, no cards or enchants, no affixes. Leave empty for none.
